scope: Manual review of exact-source control flow and complete retained Go test output, supplemented by raw response validation. No independent post-run database query or detached database dump.

control_flow.post_drain_physical_sql_and_owner_traver: Unconditional after workers.Wait and CSV preservation; all complete before the final latency assertion.
control_flow.conclusion: The SQL counts and complete owner traversals were reached and completed without reported assertion failure. This narrower conclusion does not turn the failed Go test or final qualification into PASS.

limitations: Successful assertions do not print individual result rows. Expected physical counts are source oracles supported by execution flow, not independently recounted raw database records.
Schema 69 integrity and the broader qualification matrix are reviewed separately.
The generic automated verifier deliberately requires whole-test PASS for its standalone database_integrity verdict.
